The five frames show an indoor badminton court with several players roughly 5–15 meters ahead. They generally face the net or one another and move laterally across the court. The camera wearer is near the court boundary, with a badminton racket visible close in the foreground and no person immediately within reach. The players occupy the active play area, so entering now could obstruct their paths; waiting and offering to join the next game is the most socially appropriate choice.
